About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

result.description:
Solution Architect  
   
 PERSOL is one of Australia's largest and longest serving recruitment providers. Delivering both quality temporary and permanent options, we specialise in the recruitment of Professional, ICT, Government, STEM, Management and Executive talent. 
 Our client is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to join a high-performing team delivering complex and innovative software solutions within a large-scale industrial and technology environment. 
   
 Roster:                  Monday-Friday Perth based 
 Start date:           ASAP 
 Duration:             approx. 12 months - depending on client requirements 
 Pay Rate:              $110.00 p/h + Super depending on experience 
   
  Please note that only people with relevant experience will be considered and contacted.  
   
  The Role:   
 This position plays a critical role in bridging business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring solutions are scalable, efficient and aligned with broader product strategies and architectural standards. 
 Working closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, Systems Engineers, Development Teams and QA, you will be responsible for designing solutions that extend and enhance existing systems while supporting seamless integration across multiple technologies and platforms. 
   
  Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:     
 
 Develop solution designs aligned with established architecture frameworks, product standards and high-level system designs. 
 Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 Break solution designs into clear and actionable work packages for software delivery teams. 
 Define system dependencies and interface requirements to ensure successful integration across multiple components and systems. 
 Ensure all solution designs comply with functional safety and engineering requirements. 
 Analyse existing systems and identify opportunities for enhancement, optimisation and standardisation. 
 Provide technical guidance and design support throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Define API and third-party integration methods in accordance with established standards. 
 Select and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks for efficient implementation. 
 Produce and maintain architecture documentation, including system diagrams, component interactions and data flows. 
 
  Required Experience:   
 
 Extensive experience designing and delivering complex software solutions. 
 Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices. 
 Proven experience with systems integration, APIs and interface design. 
 Experience translating high-level requirements into detailed technical designs. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Experience working within Agile or product-based delivery environments. 
 Exposure to work package creation and project delivery methodologies. 
 
  Highly Regarded:   
 
 Experience within mining, industrial technology, autonomous systems, robotics, defence or heavy industry environments. 
 Exposure to functional safety standards and requirements. 
 Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering and software teams. 
 
   
  If you are interested in the role and fit the criteria, please apply online today! If you have any further questions before applying online, please email Holly Storor at    holly.storor@persolapac.com   
     
  **PLEASE NOTE - only applicants with recent experience will be considered**  
   

  Who we are  
 At  PERSOL , we connect people to meaningful work and growth. With decades of experience and a future-focused mindset, we're here to support your career journey. We offer fresh opportunities, trusted guidance, and a people-first approach. 
 We're committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace that embraces diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We strongly encourage applications from women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, and individuals from all communities. 
  Ready to make your next move?  Apply now to join our team. 
 To learn more about life at PERSOL, visit  persolaustralia.com  Or follow us on LinkedIn at  linkedin.com/company/persolapac  for the latest updates and opportunities.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Specialist to join our team supporting telecommunications platforms and applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, performance optimisation, security, and availability of enterprise database environments while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

· Administer, maintain, and support enterprise database environments across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery platforms.

· Ensure database availability, performance, integrity, and security for mission-critical telecommunications applications.

· Perform proactive monitoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, and health checks.

· Manage database installations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and configuration changes.

· Support incident, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes.

· Investigate and resolve database-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.

· Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize service disruptions.

· Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.

· Support high availability and business continuity requirements for telecom services.

· Collaborate with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to ensure optimal platform performance.

· Develop and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks.

· Participate in planned maintenance activities and on-call support rotations as required.

· Ensure compliance with security policies, governance standards, and operational procedures.

· Identify opportunities for automation and continuous service improvement.

Required Experience

· Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Database Administration or Database Support roles.

· Experience working within Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support environments.

· Proven experience supporting large-scale, high-availability database platforms.

· Experience managing production environments with strict SLA and KPI requirements.

· Experience supporting telecommunications, service provider, or mission-critical enterprise environments is highly desirable.

Technical SkillsDatabase Technologies

· Oracle Database

· Microsoft SQL Server

· MySQL

· PostgreSQL

Database Administration

· Database Installation and Configuration

· Performance Monitoring and Tuning

· Backup and Recovery

· Replication and High Availability

· Database Security and Access Management

· Capacity Planning

· Patch Management and Upgrades

Operational Support

· Incident Management

· Problem Management

· Change Management

· Root Cause Analysis

· Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

· Service Monitoring and Reporting

Scripting & Automation

· SQL

· Shell/Bash Scripting

· PowerShell

· Python (desirable)

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft SQL Server Certification, or equivalent database certifications.

· ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

· Experience supporting Telecom OSS/BSS platforms, Billing Systems, CRM platforms, Subscriber Management Systems, or Network Management Systems is highly desirable.

· Experience working within 24x7 operational support environments.

Key Attributes

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Managed Services environment.

· Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining operational stability and service quality.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: From $90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation
